text: Hue: from planning more than 1,000 ha to shaping a hi-tech hub
Beyond planning a 1,081-ha High-Tech Park, central Hue City is also promoting three technology projects with a combined projected investment of more than VND4.5 trillion (nearly $175 million).
Land preparation, infrastructure development, and investor attraction efforts are paving the way for the city to establish a comprehensive technology ecosystem.

Recently, Chairman of the City People's Committee, Mr. Le Tri Thanh, conducted a survey of sites designated for science and technology development and held working sessions with agencies under the Department of Science and Technology.
The focus was on reviewing land resources, preparing infrastructure, and accelerating key technology projects.
Notably, in Hung Loc Commune, the city is planning a High-Tech Park covering 1,081 ha.
The area is intended to become a hub for high-tech research and application, business incubation, workforce training, and pilot manufacturing activities.
Priority sectors include artificial intelligence (AI), cloud computing, biotechnology, biomedical technology, advanced materials, and advanced manufacturing technologies.
The plan has already been approved by the City's Party Committee and is currently under review by the city government for final approval.
Alongside the High-Tech Park, Hue is preparing to invest in three technology projects in the Vy Da Ward area, focusing on data infrastructure, digital technology, and software production.
One of these projects is a Digital Data Center located in Zone A of the An Van Duong New Urban Area, covering nearly 6,600 sq.m and requiring an estimated investment of VND274 billion ($9.6 million).
The project aims to support heritage data digitization and applications of artificial intelligence, the Internet of Things (IoT), 3D technology, and big data.
Related procedures are currently being finalized, with construction expected to begin in the fourth quarter of 2026.
A larger project is the Concentrated Digital Technology Park, spanning more than 27 ha with an estimated investment of VND2.452 trillion ($95 million).
The project aims to develop a Smart Media City while creating employment opportunities for approximately 5,000 workers.
The invitation-for-investment dossier has been approved, and SMC Hue Co., Ltd. has expressed interest in the project.
Construction is expected to commence in the fourth quarter of 2027.
Meanwhile, the Technology and Software Production Park in Zone E will cover more than 5 ha and require an estimated investment of over VND1.777 trillion ($69 million).
The city is currently completing the necessary procedures, with groundbreaking scheduled for the third quarter of 2027.
In parallel with technology infrastructure development, Hue is investing in facilities that support research, startups, and the commercialization of science and technology products.
Among them, the City Innovation and Startup Center in Zone E of the An Van Duong New Urban Area is expected to become a key component of the city's innovation ecosystem.
The facility has a total investment of VND120 billion, featuring six floors and a total floor area of approximately 6,220 sq.m.
It will support business incubation, startup assistance, research, testing, and training activities.
